text: Zara Ahmed's security review tests the Scripted REST API directly -- not just the portal partners already use.
Authenticated as a real Driscoll test user, she requests claims using Castle Rock Tooling's partner_company value instead of her own.
The response comes back with Castle Rock Tooling's claim -- even though she's logged in as Driscoll.
The table's ACL is correct -- the API's GET handler just queries with plain GlideRecord, which never asks it anything.
Confirmed and reported to Dmitri and Natalie. Next: the fix.
